verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an agent create API, a CLI that manages agents, calls and phone numbers 'no dashboard tab required', an API quickstart that places a call, and an official MCP server, so the core end-to-end flow is covered programmatically. Two caveats keep it from full: API keys are generated by clicking a button in the dashboard, and provider integrations are connected from the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit documentation of attaching a phone number to an agent via API/CLI/MCP, MCP tool coverage for agent creation and calling, programmatic API key provisioning, hands-on or independent corroboration of a fully headless end-to-end run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my coding agent can provision a complete voice agent end to end — create the agent, attach a number, and place a call — through the API, CLI, or MCP without touching the dashboard

citations.quote: lets you manage agents, calls, phone numbers, and batches directly from your terminal — no dashboard tab required.
